# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU rendering arrives** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback. The Skia m152 release adds a Silk.NET Vulkan integration and file-backed fonts on Nano Server. It also strengthens native-object lifetimes, reduces copying, and improves native symbol packages.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152** — Updates the engine to m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, with subsequent servicing corrections including safe cached-data mutex cleanup. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite contexts and recordings** — Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and SKGraphiteImageCache. Graphite uses explicit record/snap/insert/submit operations; Ganesh remains unchanged. Browser WebGPU uses Dawn, and Graphite readback is asynchronous. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous RGBA pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Copy data before the callback returns; use GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion to drain submitted Ganesh work. Failure delivers a null result. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with GRSilkNetBackendContext and typed extension initialization, and makes GRVkExtensions() public. Existing SharpVk integration remains available. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Keep borrowed native storage alive** — Region iterators retain their source region, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing collection from leaving dangling native references. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Release owned resources deterministically** — Fixes pixel-buffer cleanup when raster SKImage.Create fails, disposes the previous buffer on SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset, and releases consumed non-memory-backed streams when their HarfBuzz blob is released. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Less copying and allocation** — SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets; .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 retain the buffered path. Font.Shape avoids copying caller feature arrays, tag formatting avoids char boxing, and text encoding and wrapper lookup reduce overhead. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Load fonts explicitly on Nano Server** — The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so fonts loaded with SKTypeface.FromStream/FromData/FromFile can render. Its empty default font manager still supplies no system fonts; normal Windows builds retain DirectWrite. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging symbols** — Produces separate Apple symbol packages with complete dSYMs while keeping customer runtime packages symbol-free. Android libraries retain deterministic build IDs and matching split-debug identities. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## Bug Fixes

- **Avoid stale GPU readbacks** — Carries upstream Ganesh corrections for readbacks after failed flushes and further font-rendering and GPU stability fixes. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids char boxing. Apple symbol packages add complete dSYMs, while Android native libraries carry deterministic build IDs and matching debug identities.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 restored Silk.NET package production, reduced shaping allocations, and fixed uniform-buffer and stream cleanup. It also added Apple symbol packages and deterministic Android debug identities.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0-preview.1.1...v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Silk.NET Vulkan helper. It also added Nano Server font loading and fixed region, pixmap, and raster-image lifetimes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.5...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
